features.title: Inkling 2 Mini host path: 4.1x faster (row-wise expert dequant, threaded MoE/head/projections)
features.observed: prefill 1.84 s/token, decode 1.93 s/token at 16 threads (was 7.6-8.0 s/token). Perplexity unchanged at 1.317 over 37 tokens, top-1 34/37; greedy still yields ' Paris.'. Thread scaling measured at 1/4/8/16 threads: 6.47/2.52/2.08/1.84 s/token.
features.note: Host-only path: no GPU kernels, so prefill and decode are the same rate (one position at a time). First token after load is slower (cold page cache over 12.7 GB of weights). Next: grouped expert GEMV on gfx1201, then a batched prefill path.

features.title: Full 48-visit Inkling 2 Mini forward: logits from real weights
features.observed: Held-out prose: 37 tokens -> perplexity 1.317, top-1 34/37; 58 tokens -> perplexity 2.298, top-1 50/58 (misses on the digits of '1969'). Greedy from 'The capital of France is' -> ' Paris.' 200058/200058 logits finite, repeat run bit-identical, 7.6 s/token single-threaded.
features.note: Behavioural verification only: the transformers reference needs the 20.2 GB HF checkpoint and torch/transformers, neither on disk. Speed work not started (no kernels in this path), Strata still a measurement, no 200k-context run.

features.title: Output head: final block-residual query, output_norm, unpadded unembed matvec, logit softcap
features.observed: 3 tests pass. softcap is bounded by c (asymptote, not a clamp), odd and monotone; block_residual output lies inside the convex hull of the RMS-normalised snapshots and is deterministic; logits over a 2-row synthetic unembedding are opposite in sign for opposite rows, bounded by 30, and repeat exactly. Unembedding streams rows; 200058 real rows of the 201024 padded.
features.note: Not yet connected to a full stack: layers 1-23, the 3x loop over 6-18 with the 13 gate tensors, and the per-layer sliding/full variants are still unwired, so no model logits exist.

features.title: Block-boundary residual and mlp_input attention for layer 0
features.observed: |residual| now equals |post| (7.301 for token 785) instead of embedding+attn (48.562), confirming the block boundary performs no residual add; the MoE input comes from the 1-query attention over [embedding, attn_out] with |norm_in| 51.678/50.317/48.943 against |ffn_norm.weight| 50.492. Expert ids change accordingly and weights still sum to 8.0; all finite.
features.note: Comparison against the transformers reference is blocked on this machine: no torch/transformers installed, no HF safetensors checkpoint on disk (only the GGUF), and llama.cpp b11050 rejects inkling2_loop. Layers 1-23, the loop gates, the final norm, output matvec and final_logit_softcapping are still unwired, so no logit exists.

features.title: Layer-0 top-8 MoE on real weights: router, softcapped SwiGLU, per-expert outer scale
features.observed: Router picks 8 distinct experts per token with weights summing to 8.0 (the routed scaling factor), e.g. [40,18,125,11,124,114,95,89] with weights [1.097,1.112,0.973,0.979,1.008,0.965,0.932,0.935]. FFN half runs in reference order (post_attention_layernorm -> MoE -> post_mlp_conv -> residual): |moe_out| 122.2/97.0/143.5, |layer_out| 61.4/64.9/75.6, all finite. 3 MoE unit tests pass (softcap saturation, hand-computed SwiGLU, select-on-biased/weight-on-raw routing).
features.note: Still no logit: the block attention residual (mlp_input) between attention and FFN is not modelled, and layers 1-23, the final norm, output matvec and softcapping are unwired. The router activation (sigmoid vs softmax) is not named in the checkpoint; sigmoid is the default because exp_probs_b.bias is a noaux-tc feature, and --router-softmax switches it.

features.title: Layer 0 of Inkling-2-Mini runs end to end on real weights (embedding through attention residual)
features.observed: Five tokens through layer 0 produce finite activations: |q|=49.5/49.1/47.3/47.2/50.6, |k|=29.8->53.7 (conv accumulating history), |v|=32.000 on every step = sqrt(8 kv heads x 128) which is the exact norm of an unweighted RMSNorm over 1024 elements, gate_mean 0.34-0.51, |attn| 24.8-40.9, |post| 7.3-25.0, |residual| 48.6-53.3. sink[0..4]=[0.64,1.29,2.79,0.61], bias at distance 0 ~[-0.2, 1.5], head-0 attention ~0.004-0.020.
features.note: One layer's attention contribution, not a logit: the MoE FFN, the 13 loop gates, the block attention residuals and the remaining 23 layers are unwired.

features.title: Projection post-processing on device: 4-tap causal conv, per-head clips, RMSNorm, output gate
features.observed: 4 GPU tests pass. gpu_post_qkv_matches_the_cpu_reference_over_chained_steps compares q/k/v/gate and both conv caches against inkling2_attn::post_qkv over 4 decode steps; the other three cover decode attention at pos 0/7/1100 with windows {none,8,3,1,1024,17}, all-masked -> zeros, and the host preprocessing helpers. CPU side: 15 attention tests.
features.note: Still not a forward pass: the matvecs that produce the raw projections, the top-8 MoE, the 13 loop gates and the block attention residuals are unwired.

features.title: inkling2_attn_decode_f32 HIP kernel verified against the CPU reference on GPU
features.observed: GPU output matches inkling2_attn::decode_head at pos 0/7/1100 with windows {none,8,3,1,1024,17} within 2e-4 + 2e-3|ref| (pos 1100 exercises distances past the 1024 relative extent). An all-masked row returns exactly zero, not NaN. window==0 now means 'hide everything' and u32::MAX means unbounded; the previous 0==unbounded encoding could not express the masked-out case.
features.note: Still no forward pass: the kernel takes q/k/v/bias/sink as inputs, so the projections, MoE, loop gates and block attention residuals remain before a token can be generated.

features.title: inkling2_loop attention core as a CPU reference: relative bias, L2 clips, log-scale, short convs, sink softmax, output gate
features.observed: 12 unit tests pass, transcribed from transformers' modeling_inkling2_loop.py. Hand-computed: L2 clip (3,4)->(1.2,1.6) at threshold 2; log scale 1.0 below floor 8192 and 1+0.1*ln2 above; relative-bias gather for distances 0..2 with future keys and distance>=extent zeroed; sink softmax 1/3+1/3 neutral and ~0 at sink=+100; 4-tap causal conv t=0,1,2,4 -> 4,11,20,40 with cache chaining; decode_head equals a naive full-row reference for windows none/6/3/1; window 4 selects positions 6..9 (mean 7.5); all-masked row returns zeros, not NaN.
features.note: This is the ordering oracle the future v_wmma kernel must match, per the AGENTS.md rule that device code ships with a CPU reference. Not yet wired to a model: the projections (W_q/W_k/W_v/W_gate/W_rel/W_sink), the MoE FFN and the loop gates are still unimplemented.

features.title: IQ2_XS/IQ2_S/IQ3_XXS/IQ3_S dequant with generated ggml tables; every Inkling tensor type loadable
features.observed: arch-check reports no blocking types (all 12 present types are supported). --dequant-smoke dequantises the first 8 blocks of one real tensor per type from the mmap: all finite, and expert tensors land at +/-0.08 once the per-expert outer scale (~4e-05, companion `ffn_*_exps.scale`) is applied, matching the non-expert weights. 20 gguf lib tests pass, including a FNV-1a table-integrity digest over the 2,300 generated ggml constants and hand-computed IQ2_XS/IQ3_S scale and sign cases.
features.note: Grids/sign tables are generated from ggml-common.h by scripts/gen-iq-tables.py rather than transcribed; the digest test fails if a table is hand-edited. The outer-scale multiplication is a loader responsibility, not part of dequant_row.

features.title: Dequantise BF16, Q5_K, Q3_K, IQ4_NL and NVFP4; identify GGML type 40 as NVFP4
features.observed: 14 lib tests + 10 adversarial integration tests pass. arch-check on Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q3_K_XL now lists only four unsupported types (IQ2_XS, IQ2_S, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S) instead of nine; every other role reports `ok`. Type 40 is 4.5 bits/weight = 8 bytes E2M1 + 1 byte UE4M3 scale per 16 values, i.e. NVFP4, matching ggml's `block_nvfp4` (36 bytes / 64 elements).
features.note: The four remaining IQ types need ggml's grid/codebook tables (256-1024 entries each), which is data entry rather than arithmetic.

features.title: inkling2_loop architecture contract: 42 tensor roles, layer variants, loop schedule, checked against the checkpoint
features.observed: `scoria arch-check` on Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q3_K_XL finds every required role with 0 missing across 42 roles: 20 sliding-window layers carry a fused `attn_norm`, the 4 full-history layers (5/11/17/23) carry `attn_{q,k,v}_inp_norm` plus `attn_{k,v}_conv_proj`, and the 12 looped layers carry 13 `loop_*_ctrl_*`/`loop_msg_query` tensors. Schedule expands to 48 visits (6 direct + 36 looped + 6 tail) and 48 KV slots. Remaining work is dequantisation only: Q5K, BF16, Q3K, IQ2_XS, IQ2_S, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S, IQ4_NL and GGML type 40 (unknown to this tree). 6 unit tests cover the schedule and the two layer variants.
features.note: FP8 conversion is available on gfx1201 and verified by compiling probes: `v_cvt_pk_fp8_f32` (f32x2 -> fp8x2) and `v_cvt_f32_fp8_e32` (fp8 -> f32), neither banned; FP8 WMMA already measures 383.76 TFLOPS in `scoria gate`.

features.title: Sliding-window-aware KV budget planner and measured Strata paging prototype for Inkling 2 Mini
features.observed: inkling2_loop now parses (per-layer head_count/head_count_kv arrays, sliding_window_pattern bool array, expert_count, loop.count/start/end). `scoria plan` on Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q3_K_XL (12.70 GiB): 48 KV slots = 8 full-history + 40 windowed (window 1024), 65536 B/token FP32, 32768 FP16, 16384 FP8; 200k context costs 12.52/6.26/3.13 GiB, and with 15.69 GiB free the max context is 43963 (FP32) / 93047 (FP16) / 191214 (FP8) tokens. `scoria strata` measured 11.36 GiB of experts (48 tensors, 1.42-2.85 MiB slabs), 727.1 MiB routed per token at top-8 of 128 (6.2%), 1.57 GB/s buffered after O_DIRECT was rejected on btrfs compress=zstd -> 2 tok/s paged ceiling. 3 KV-budget unit tests added.
features.note: Strata is a fallback, not a substitute for residency: the 11.36 GiB expert set is 6.2% routed per token, so only a hot-expert cache makes paging competitive. Full Inkling inference still needs the inkling2_loop kernels; llama.cpp b11050 cannot load the architecture, so there is no reference logits from it.
